feed.title: Google Cloud: Binary Authorization
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Binary Authorization

entry.content: To provide long-term security and address threats from future quantum computers, Binary Authorization supports keys that use post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms. These algorithms, such as ML-DSA-65 (Dilithium3), are standardized to be resistant to attacks from both classical and quantum computers. To learn how to generate a PQC key pair and create an attestor, see Create post-quantum cryptography (PQC) keys.
entry.summary: Binary Authorization now supports keys using post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms, like ML-DSA-65. This enhances long-term security against future quantum computer threats by using algorithms resistant to both classical and quantum attacks. Learn more about generating PQC keys and creating attestors.
